home_subline: Crafting modern UI/UX and polished digital products
docs_subline: A quiet library of parts — builder, factory, lib.
docs_desc_button: A pressable action with intent variants and sizes.
docs_desc_input: A labelled text field for short single-line entry.
docs_desc_slider: A range control for picking a value along a track.
docs_desc_dialog: A framed surface for focused content and actions.
docs_desc_radio_group: A single choice among a small set of options.
docs_desc_tag: A compact label for status, metadata, or filters.
docs_desc_picker: A segmented control for switching between options.
docs_desc_form_builder: Schema-driven forms with validation, sections, and pluggable field adapters.
docs_desc_data_view: Headless table with filtering, sorting, selection, and cursor pagination.
docs_desc_page_builder: Composes tabbed pages from data views, modals, and actions.
docs_desc_detail_builder: Declarative detail layouts with field, cursor, and custom sections.
docs_desc_modal: Route-aware modal shell with drafts, forms, and row actions.
docs_desc_activity_tree: Graph view of activity flows built on xyflow and dagre layout.
docs_desc_list_view: A simple list surface with loading and empty states.
docs_desc_timeline_section: A vertical timeline for ordered steps and events.
